description: EPCOR Distribution & Transmission Inc. (EDTI) Edmonton 'Electricity tariffs and riders' page excerpt (accordion sections DAS, SAS, Riders G/DJ/J/K, plus L and Local Access Fee as ignored sections; first list items only) and the current editions it links: DAS tariff January 2026 (cover 'Effective January 1, 2026'; PDF pages 1 cover, 3-9 price schedules DAS-R/SC/MC/TOU(+continued)/TOUP(+continued), 20 Rider E, 21 Rider DG table, 25 Table 1), SAS tariff January 2026 (pages 1 cover, 3-9 SAS-R/SC/MC/TOU/TOUP, 25 Table 3), Rider G January 2026, Rider J January 2026 and Rider K October 2026 (page 1 each). Every price schedule is stamped '(2026 INTERIM RATE)'. Page text exactly as returned by scrapers.utils.parsing.extract_pdf_pages(); original PDF page numbers retained.
notes: Rider DJ: newest posted edition is January 2020 (https://www.epcor.com/content/dam/epcor/documents/rates/riders/2020-01_rider-dj.pdf), older than the January 2026 DAS tariff, so it is not fetched or applied. Rider K July 2026 (https://www.epcor.com/content/dam/epcor/documents/rates/riders/2026-07-rider-k.pdf) yields 0 text pages with extract_pdf_pages (image-only PDF).

calculated on a rate base of net book value and will include return, depreciation, and operations and
maintenance costs.
Application

facilities are added or currently installed facilities are retired.
